candidate_generation_config.selection_anchor: The 118-row outcome-blind roster in data/alpha_search/sec_selling_holder_overhang_roster_20260824.json was frozen before any post-acceptance price access: 38/45/35 rows across old_thin/mid_weak/late_strong, 84 unique tickers, 103 entry dates, and no more than three rows on one date.
candidate_generation_config.selection_policy: Generate exactly one research-only candidate on the newly materialized selling-holder economics field. Do not sweep form set, parser rules, offering amount, liquidity floors, cooldown, cost, borrow stress, hold, or comparator; do not read any post-decision price before reservation.

candidate_snapshots.hypothesis: Shorting a liquid active common stock and buying equal-notional SPY at the first regular-session open strictly after an accepted S-1/F-1 whose primary document affirmatively identifies selling holders produces positive H10 pair replacement value after two-leg costs and conservative borrow stress, because secondary-holder resale creates incremental float supply without delivering cash to the issuer and that distinction is obscured when registration statements are treated as one generic dilution category.

provenance.baseline_policy: Equal-notional long SPY over each frozen stock interval is the market hedge; zero pair return is the replacement-value hurdle.
provenance.price_clock: Both legs enter at the first regular-session open strictly after SEC accepted_at and exit at the tenth session close counting entry.

independent_evidence.decision_exclusions: No price after accepted_at, return, PnL, outcome label, filing-form reslice, amount threshold, or parser alternative enters roster selection.
Current reference metadata, FIGIs, future revisions, and bars not completed by SEC accepted_at are excluded.

expectation_gap.gap_definition: The observable market prior groups S-1/F-1 registrations as generic financing or dilution. The frozen sidecar separates a sharper case: shares registered for selling holders can expand tradable supply while the issuer receives no corresponding proceeds, so equal treatment of primary issuance and secondary resale may underprice the supply overhang.

affected_tickers: 84 unique liquid active common stocks in the frozen 118-row roster
transmission.catalyst: SEC acceptance of an S-1, S-1/A, F-1, or F-1/A whose primary document contains affirmative selling-holder resale evidence.
transmission.expected_direction: The stock underperforms equal-notional SPY from the next open through the tenth session close, making short-stock plus long-SPY pair value positive after costs and borrow stress.
transmission.half_life: First regular-session open after SEC acceptance through the tenth session close counting entry.

candidate_snapshots.why_not_arbitraged: Registration statements mix IPOs, primary capital raises, amendments, mixed offerings, and secondary resales; ticker identity is noisy, the effective sale date is uncertain, borrow can be expensive, and most event feeds expose form metadata rather than parsed selling-holder economics. The frozen filter removes IPO and non-common-stock rows but still leaves timing and locate risk, which is why the result must clear a deliberately severe execution stress before it earns further work.
candidate_snapshots.falsifier: Reject unless the frozen roster remains exactly 118 decisions with 38/45/35 rows in old_thin/mid_weak/late_strong, at least 30 decisions in every window, and the short-stock plus equal-notional long-SPY pair has strictly positive aggregate net value and strictly positive net value in every canonical window after 90bp two-leg round-trip cost plus 20% annualized stock-borrow carry for 10/252 years. The aggregate must remain positive under double two-leg cost (180bp) plus the same borrow stress; maximum single-ticker positive contribution must be at most 40%, top-five at most 60%, and contribution HHI at most 0.25. Missing either leg, missing locate proxy, revised decision-time identity, or any outcome field in selection invalidates rather than retunes the run.

baseline.policy: Equal-notional long SPY over each frozen next-open-to-H10 interval; zero return on the market-hedged pair is the primary replacement-value hurdle.

treatment.policy: For all 118 hash-frozen selling-holder decisions, short the event stock and buy equal-notional SPY at the first regular-session open strictly after SEC accepted_at, close both at the tenth session close, apply 90bp base pair cost plus 20% annualized borrow carry, and report the predeclared 180bp pair-cost stress without changing forms, parser, liquidity floors, cooldown, hold, or sample.

candidate_snapshots.replacement_value_comparator: Zero-return cash on the equal-dollar market-hedged pair is primary; the short stock leg is also reported against zero-return cash descriptively, but cannot rescue a failed pair verdict.

execution_envelope.borrow_dependency: Every research row assumes stock borrow at 20% annualized for 10/252 years; paper or live use remains blocked until broker locate is proven per ticker at decision time.
execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: Fixed $2,000 per leg, at most three rows on one entry date in the frozen roster; no capital is allocated by this research run.
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: Base verdict charges 90bp total round-trip cost across both legs plus 20% annualized stock-borrow carry for 10/252 years; stress verdict doubles the two-leg cost to 180bp with unchanged borrow carry.
execution_envelope.intended_instrument: Short active common stock plus equal-notional long SPY; no options, leverage, present-day ticker remapping, or unlocated live short.
execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: Latest 20 completed sessions known at accepted_at must have median dollar volume at least $1,000,000 and the last completed close at least $3.
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: SEC accepted_at is the decision clock; entry is the first regular-session open strictly afterward and both legs exit at the tenth session close counting entry.
